verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API whose endpoints carry a version prefix (e.g. `GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`), so some API versioning is evidenced. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, a versioning or stability guarantee, or a changelog for breaking changes. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning/stability guarantees, API changelog or sunset timelines, independent corroboration.
